nodes.description: Public owner address of the Owned contract; set from msg.sender at deployment and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address awaiting acceptOwnership; two-step ownership handover slot.
mapping(address => uint) token balances of the Substancia token.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowance table used by approve/transferFrom.
_totalSupply, the fixed minted token supply of 15,500,000 * 10**18.
Token symbol, set to "SUBS" in the constructor.
Token name, set to "Substancia" in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
SafeMath.add, checked addition used for credit operations.
SafeMath.sub, checked subtraction used for debit operations.
SafeMath.mul, checked multiplication.
SafeMath.div, checked division with zero guard.
Owned constructor: assigns msg.sender as owner.
transferOwnership(address), onlyOwner: stages a new owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, then promotes and clears newOwner.
Substancia constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints fixed supply to owner and emits Transfer.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address): read-only balance lookup.
transfer(address,uint): debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[to].
approve(address,uint): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom(address,address,uint): debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits balances[to].
allowance(address,address): read-only allowance lookup.
approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes): sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Fallback function: payable but immediately reverts, rejecting ETH.
transferAnyERC20Token(address,uint), onlyOwner: external call to pull arbitrary ERC20 tokens to owner.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance indexing and allowance indexing.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender,tokens,this,data) to an arbitrary attacker-supplied contract, executed before any state finalization.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner,tokens) on an arbitrary caller-supplied token address.
Parameter to of transfer(address to, uint tokens).
Parameter tokens of transfer(address to, uint tokens).
Parameter spender of approve(address spender, uint tokens).
Parameter tokens of approve(address spender, uint tokens).
Parameter from of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens).
Parameter to of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens).
Parameter tokens of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens).
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf(address tokenOwner).
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender).
Parameter spender of allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender).
Parameter spender of approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data); also the address of the externally called contract.
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data).
Parameter data of approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data), forwarded verbatim to the external callee.
Parameter tokenAddress of transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens); address of the externally called token contract.
Parameter tokens of transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens).
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership(address _newOwner).

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored into owner during the Owned constructor, establishing the privileged account.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier which requires msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before promoting ownership.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by onlyOwner which requires msg.sender == owner.
transfer debits and credits mappings indexed by the caller address msg.sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], caller-controlled allowance ownership.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender], caller-controlled spender indexing.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and passes msg.sender to the external callee.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner authorization check.
owner is read by onlyOwner and used as the destination of the recovered ERC20 tokens.
newOwner is compared against msg.sender and then promoted to owner.
Owned constructor writes owner.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
Constructor assigns the fixed minted supply to _totalSupply.
Constructor credits balances[owner] with the whole supply.
Constructor sets the symbol string.
Constructor sets the name string.
Constructor sets the decimals value.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the supply.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed allowance mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
totalSupply uses SafeMath.sub for the supply calculation.
transfer uses SafeMath.sub to debit the sender balance, guarding against underflow.
transfer uses SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance, guarding against overflow.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for both balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance.
approveAndCall performs an external call to the attacker-supplied spender contract's receiveApproval, which can re-enter the token contract.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into a caller-supplied token contract, which can re-enter this contract.
The spender parameter directly determines the external callee address of receiveApproval.
The tokens parameter is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
The tokenAddress parameter directly determines the external callee of the ERC20 transfer call.
The tokens parameter is forwarded into the external ERC20 transfer call.
Destination address parameter is used to credit balances[to].
Amount parameter drives the subtraction and addition in transfer.
Spender parameter is the second key of allowed[msg.sender][spender].
Amount parameter is stored into the allowance slot.
From parameter indexes balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender].
To parameter is the destination of the credited balance.
Amount parameter drives the debits and credit in transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping read.
tokenOwner parameter is the outer key of the allowance lookup.
spender parameter is the inner key of the allowance lookup.
_newOwner parameter sets the pending privileged owner account.
